## Objective
- Build a polished, playable browser game from the user's one-line pitch: "GOD COMPLEX — Everyone has a unique ability. Yours? You can steal the abilities of anyone who defeats you. Build the ultimate power and become unstoppable."

## Requirements
- The user gave only the game premise; no explicit tech or scope constraints.
- Deliverable inferred and built as a static HTML/CSS/JS game in the PlayGround repo.
- Must work on desktop and mobile, with usable touch controls and responsive safe-area layout.
- Core mechanic must center on losing to enemies to steal their abilities; winning should grant nothing.
- Use the repo's static `index.html` serving flow and verify in a real browser via `playwright-cli`.

## Decisions
- Built a turn-based cosmic arena RPG with energy, block, statuses, cooldowns, and 3-slot loadouts.
- 7 gods plus a final boss, each with a unique stealable ability, passive, intent pattern, and dialogue.
- Losing grants the boss's ability permanently, +5 max HP per stolen gift, and +1 base strike per stolen gift; winning marks the boss beaten but steals nothing.
- Added a `YIELD` action so deliberate losing is first-class; result modals explain the rule.
- Final boss can be beaten for the "hollow ending," or allowed to win for the true "APOTHEOSIS" ending.
- Abilities auto-equip when a slot is free; when full, the defeat modal directs the player to manage loadout.
- Combat engine is pure and testable in Node (`engine.js`); UI/rendering lives in `game.js`.
- Used procedural SVG sigils, canvas starfield, WebAudio synth, CSS animations, and modal result screens instead of external art/assets.
- Added a temporary dev hook `window.__gc` enabled only at URL hash `#dev` for testing later-game states (must be removed before finalizing).
- Balance testing showed every boss is beatable after stealing its own gift, and the final is beatable with defensive builds; farmed all-gift runs work.

## Work State
### Completed
- `engine.js`: full battle engine, abilities, bosses, statuses, passives, cooldowns, yields, event output, player stat scaling.
- `game.js`: title, rules modal, ladder, arsenal/loadout, battles, action cards, intent display, result modals, endings, audio, starfield, keyboard shortcuts, mobile interactions.
- `index.html`: semantic shell/screens/modal/toast/arena markup.
- `styles.css`: full cosmic visual system, title screen, ladder, battle, responsive mobile overrides, animations, safe areas.
- Verified title, rules, ladder, yield confirmation, defeat/steal modal, victory modal, final battle, true ending, hollow ending, and mobile layouts via screenshots.
- Desktop battle composition improved with arena rings, giant ring-numeral watermark, larger portraits, and center chronicle line.
- Mobile battle reordered into a grid: enemy top, chronicle center, player bottom; fixed layout defects.
- Mini sigils thickened for readability in ladder rows and gift chips.
- All tested interactions produced no console errors.

### Active
- Final mobile QA of battle with multiple abilities (`screenshots/mobile-battle-abilities.png` just captured; needs inspection).
- Minor polish/UX cleanup before final submission.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/mobile-battle-abilities.png`; confirm 3 ability cards are reachable by horizontal scroll and that the deck fits above the bottom safe area.
2. Add a mobile-visible `LOADOUT` shortcut in the ladder header so players can jump to/manage the arsenal (desktop arsenal is already visible; hide shortcut ≥981px).

5. Run final end-to-end pass: fresh start → yield to Ember → steal Cinder → rematch → win → next ring; verify victory modal when gift is *unclaimed* (not yet tested).
